content: 生成一段30秒、16:9横屏、24fps的真人电影短片，画面始终填满横向画幅。时间段是节奏预算，不要求逐帧精确切点。所有镜头发生在同一场夜雨中的日式宅邸回廊，只在标明位置硬切，不使用溶解、淡出或突然变速。

en.content:
Generate a 30-second live-action cinematic short film in 16:9 landscape format at 24 fps, with the frame continuously filling the horizontal canvas. The time span is a pacing budget and does not require frame-accurate cut points. All shots take place in the same corridor of a Japanese-style mansion during a rainy night, with hard cuts only at the specified positions; do not use dissolves, fades, or sudden speed changes.

Todos los planos transcurren en el mismo corredor de una casa japonesa durante una noche lluviosa, y solo se hacen cortes directos en las posiciones indicadas; no usar disoluciones, fundidos ni cambios bruscos de velocidad.
